name: GraphQL Compose Codegen MCP
description: Governed, read-only schema inspection and generation previews through Tool API.
project_description:
GraphQL Compose Codegen generates TypeScript types, GraphQL fragments, and React component stubs for Next.js frontends from your Drupal content model, so the frontend stays in sync with the schema.

 This module is for Drupal sites that serve content to a separate frontend application — often called a "headless" or "decoupled" setup. If you're using the GraphQL Compose module to expose your content as a GraphQL API, this module handles the tedious next step: writing the TypeScript types and GraphQL queries the frontend needs to consume that data.

 The graphql_compose_codegen_mcp submodule exposes the codegen inspect, diff, and preview operations as governed, read-only Tool API tools for AI agents and MCP clients, under MCP Sentinel policy. It writes no files, records no snapshot, and invokes no generation lifecycle hooks.
